key_points: Jefferies cut Tapestry's price target from $144 to $125, indicating lower near‑term expectations
The downgrade adds downward pressure, outweighing recent talk of the stock being cheap after the pullback
Mixed signals create uncertainty; the analyst revision is the dominant driver for near‑term price moves
Investors will watch for catalyst events (earnings, holiday season) to gauge true valuation
Potential for further volatility as market digests the lowered target and valuation debate
